pattern: SELECT count\(*\) as [a-zA-Z0-9]+\_contestants FROM CONTESTANTS WHERE contestant\_number NOT IN \(\s*( SELECT contestant\_number FROM VOTES GROUP BY contestant\_number HAVING COUNT\(DISTINCT phone\_number\) = 0 )\)
correction: Remove the subquery and the condition HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT phone_number) = 0 from the WHERE clause.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries where a subquery is incorrectly used in the WHERE clause, filtering out records based on an unnecessary condition.
